title: Extract common Gallery scene lifecycle
scope: Make one reusable C++ runtime own scene load/create, replacement, reset, frame state, public-command submission and teardown for every Gallery shell.
acceptance: Desktop and mobile no longer define separate scene/session ownership structures or duplicate create-step-destroy paths.
Failure, replacement and teardown tests prove recoverable state and exactly-once resource release.
evidence: PASS: env PM_DRIVER_FILES=$PWD/build-foundations/Release/manifests/slang-cpu.json PM_LAYER_FILES=$PWD/build-foundations/Release/manifests/validation.json ctest --test-dir build-foundations --output-on-failure -R '^(parallel-mater-gallery-session-contract-tests|parallel-mater-camera-controller-tests|parallel-mater-gallery-input-tests|parallel-mater-gallery-frame-timing-tests|parallel-mater-gallery-frame-timing-headless)$'; Slang CPU; 5/5 tests.

PASS: ./scripts/Run-DesktopGallery.sh --backend cuda --brick-count 4 --frames 2 --headless /tmp/f7-03-cuda.ppm and the equivalent --backend vulkan command; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU; both rendered 6.0 MiB PPMs.
PASS: ANDROID_HOME=/home/thomas/Android/Sdk ./scripts/Build-AndroidGallery.sh; NDK 29 ARM64 Vulkan debug APK; BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
